title: A galaxy of agents
label: Voice made by AI · no presenter · an illustration, not the live Galaxy

from.what: The Galaxy shown at the RiskMandate stand at Web Summit, redrawn as a new WebGL scene

scenes.title: A galaxy of agents
scenes.caption: Web Summit, November 2026
scenes.narration: At Web Summit, the stand showed a galaxy: the team, drawn as a solar system in the browser.

sources.claim: The Galaxy is the Universe of the RiskMandate team, drawn as a solar system in the browser, shown at the Web Summit stand.
sources.title: A galaxy of agents (Dinis Cruz, 20 Nov 2026)

sources.claim: The command centre that holds the Galaxy view.
sources.title: Dinis Cruz's command centre

scenes.label: people, each one a sun
scenes.narration: Each person is a sun. There were six.

sources.claim: Each person is a sun; the reading of 20 November showed agents around six people.
sources.title: A galaxy of agents (Dinis Cruz, 20 Nov 2026)

scenes.label: AI agents, each one a planet
scenes.small: One reading, early on 20 November 2026. The counts change as the repositories do.
scenes.narration: Around each person, their agents are planets. Early on the twentieth of November, the Galaxy showed one hundred and seventeen agents around six people.

sources.claim: Early on 20 November it showed 117 agents around six people; the counts are one reading and change as the repositories do.
sources.title: A galaxy of agents (Dinis Cruz, 20 Nov 2026)

scenes.label: messages between agents
scenes.small: And 50 pairs of agents in conversation, in the same reading.
scenes.narration: Between the agents, the messages they send travel as arcs of light. That reading counted two hundred and twenty-two messages, and fifty pairs of agents in conversation.

sources.claim: Messages between agents travel as arcs of light; the reading showed 222 messages and 50 pairs of agents in conversation.
sources.title: A galaxy of agents (Dinis Cruz, 20 Nov 2026)

scenes.title: Live, not a mock-up
items: Each agent's behaviour policy, one click away
Agents without a policy are counted
scenes.narration: It is not a mock-up. It reads the team's repositories live. Click an agent and you see its behaviour policy, and the agents without one are counted.

sources.claim: It is not a mock-up: it reads the team's repositories live every few minutes; each agent's behaviour policy is one click away and agents without one are counted.
sources.title: A galaxy of agents (Dinis Cruz, 20 Nov 2026)

scenes.title: What you are looking at
lines: A new drawing by c.productions, an AI agent (Claude), on your own GPU. It is not the Galaxy itself.
